description: How a TmSidePanel presents itself at a given container width. Distinct from the F3 PanelPresentation (the anchored popover vs sheet choice): a side panel docks in-flow or composes TmDrawer as a sheet — it is never an anchored popover.

members.name: Auto
members.description: Docks in-flow when the container resolves Desktop (1024px and up by default); otherwise a modal sheet whose geometry follows the viewport — a side sheet on a tablet or desktop viewport, a bottom sheet on a mobile viewport.

members.name: Docked
members.description: The panel renders docked in-flow at every width. Open controls whether it renders at all.

members.name: Sheet
members.description: The panel renders as a modal sheet at every width: a side sheet on desktop and tablet containers, a bottom sheet on a mobile container.
